content.text: The device uses sub-groups of 16, so each 256-item work-group contains 16 sub-groups, not the 32 my launch assumed. I sized the grid as `numSlice / 8` work-groups, which only covers `numSlice / 2` slices. The second half is never written, which matches the failing slices 4096 to 8191. The fix is to size the grid from the smallest sub-group size the device reports and to have each sub-group grid-stride over slices, so the result is correct for any sub-group size.
